source_evidence: You can find a firm’s or individual’s disciplinary history using our “Check Out Your Investment Professional” search tool at Investor.gov.
question: How can you research a firm’s or financial professional’s disciplinary history using the Investor.gov search tool?
answer: Choose “firm” or “individual,” enter the name, and look for “Disclosure Reported,” which indicates disciplinary history. To review details, open the individual’s “Get Full Report” and check “Disclosures.” For a firm, select “Get Details”; the location of the information depends on whether it is a brokerage or advisory firm. For dual registrants, check both.
